exercise.directions: Study the decorative reference motifs on the left. Use the center line as a mirror guide to draw and complete the symmetrical patterns on the blank right half of the calavera.
exercise.goal: Demonstrate line symmetry by analyzing reference motifs and completing the missing decorative half of a calavera mask.

questions.answer: Student accurately mirrors corresponding floral and geometric motifs across the central vertical axis.
questions.prompt: Examine the intricate floral and geometric patterns on the left reference skull. Carefully mirror these exact shapes, petals, and lines onto the blank right half of the template.

questions.answer: There are 8 marigold flowers on the entire finished mask in total.
